scope: Windows runtime resource directory initialization on first build
problem: Tauri scans bundle resources during Rust compilation, before beforeBundleCommand can stage runtime DLLs. A clean checkout initially has no ignored runtime directory.
change: The Windows MSVC build script initializes the empty runtime directory before calling tauri_build. The bundling hook still validates and fills the complete DLL set after compilation.

validation.postTauriBuildOutput: app_level_names.rs was regenerated after tauri_build returned successfully
validation.fullReleaseBuild: Still running when this narrow build-script validation was recorded; final package results are recorded separately.

limits: Only the Windows MSVC branch initializes this directory.
